newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Six Cambodians arrested under new drugs law.
newsitem.headline: Six Cambodians arrested under new drugs law.

text.p: Six Cambodians have been arrested for heroin trafficking on the same day a draconian anti-drugs law came into effect, a police official said on Wednesday.

Heng Po, chief of municipal anti-drug police, said the five men and one woman were arrested on Monday charged with trafficking 2.5 kg (5.5 lb) of heroin worth an estimated $280,000 on the street overseas.
He did not give details of the case or the suspects, except that one was a soldier.
Cambodia's new anti-drugs law, which has come under fire from human rights groups, was passed by the national assembly on Monday.
It sets a minimum sentence of 10 years and maximum sentence of life imprisonment for possession or use of any quantity of illegal drug.
Earlier this year, Cambodia was included on the United States' list of major illicit drug producing and transit countries.
